question: does an ORACLE-DISTINCT decomposed-energy verifier (mean-ranks/stddev-abstains quality ensemble + analytical penalty) beat self-consistency on a non-saturated no-cheap-oracle domain (arXiv:2605.18871)?

oracle_distinctness.note: gold (answer_choice) is used for EVAL accuracy ONLY; never passed to the generator, the quality scorer, the analytical penalty, or the judge. The energy decomposition is -mean(quality_ensemble)+analytical_penalty; uncertainty=stddev abstains to SC.
oracle_distinctness.no_model_identity_shortcut: all candidates come from ONE generator model; the scorer ranks by reasoning quality, not by candidate model_id (no model_id field is read).

interpretation: First REAL execution of the post-6/30 distributional-energy-verifier pivot on a non-saturated, no-cheap-oracle domain (the headroom ARC's generation wall cannot host). A win (energy beats SC, CI excludes 0, oracle-distinct) is the verifier-moat result; a null scopes the moat. CAVEAT: the quality scorer is an LLM process-reward ensemble (THINKPRM-style), not yet a TRAINED EBM LoRA-ensemble -- a positive justifies training the real EBM scorer next; this is the cheapest decisive first test of the oracle-distinct-energy-beats-SC thesis off ARC.
final_conclusion_n200: DECISIVE at n=200: NO method beats self-consistency on MuSR. SC=0.56 (best); cheap prompted energy verifier 0.515-0.535 (delta -0.045, CI [-0.105,+0.015] incl 0; McNemar p=0.188 -- trails SC, not significant); LLM-judge 0.545 (McNemar p=0.736 -- tied/below SC; the n=50 judge>SC was confirmed NOISE). NEGATIVE for the cheap prompted decomposed-energy verifier off ARC. Lowers the prior that training the real arXiv:2605.18871 LoRA-EBM scorer beats SC (that specific trained scorer formally untested). Off-ARC verifier moat NOT realized on MuSR with cheap prompted verifiers; SC is strong here too.
